worst_moment: "The limiting reagent is the one that runs out first based on the reaction ratio. For example, if you have 4 H2 molecules, you need 2 O2 molecules. So how many O2 molecules do you need for 6.0 g of H2?" - repeated three times after the student answered 1.5 and asked directly whether H2 is limiting.
best_moment: "The ratio tells us how much of each reactant is needed. For example, 2 H2 and 1 O2 make 2 H2O. So how many O2 molecules do you need for 3 H2 molecules?" - uses the ratio to lead the student to the needed-amount comparison.
